source.check: every name read from the page image; "no contest", no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1905. The Tandragee Rural division is not in the nomination list read and is not filed. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. Old councillors; "no contest". Thomas Collen, jun.: no party label printed in 1905. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Tandragee, Armagh County Council, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5 ("Council Elections: 2 Unionist Gains, 1 Nationalist"); candidates in the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Nominations: County Councillors")).
